title: An Interpretable, Controllable Time-Varying IIR Denoiser for On-Device Assistive Hearing
abstract: arXiv:2603.02794v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present TVBC (Time-Varying Biquad Cascade), an interpretable, low-latency speech enhancement model for real-time, on-device assistive hearing. A lightweight neural controller predicts, in real time, the coefficients of a differentiable cascade of 35 second-order IIR filters (biquads), so the model tracks non-stationary noise while keeping a fully interpretable processing chain: every spectral modification is an explicit, adjustable equalizer curve rather than an opaque `black-box' transform. Because the biquad cascade carries the signal processing, the controller can be made very small, driving the cascade with only 24k parameters at a 10.7ms algorithmic latency, within hearing-aid budgets, and running entirely on-device so that audio never leaves the device. We also expose the suppression-versus-preservation trade-off as an explicit control: it can be set during training through the loss weighting, and adjusted at inference

translated_title: 一种用于设备端辅助听力的可解释、可控的时变IIR降噪器
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TVBC（时变双二阶滤波器级联），这是一种可解释、低延迟的语音增强模型，用于实时的设备端辅助听力。一个轻量级神经控制器实时预测由35个二阶IIR滤波器（双二阶滤波器）组成的可微分级联的系数，使模型能够跟踪非平稳噪声，同时保持完全可解释的处理链：每一次频谱修改都是显式的、可调节的均衡器曲线，而非不透明的“黑盒”变换。由于双二阶滤波器级联承担了信号处理任务，控制器可以做得非常小，仅用24k参数驱动级联，算法延迟为10.7毫秒，处于助听器的资源预算范围内，并且完全在设备上运行，音频数据永远不会离开设备。我们还将噪声抑制与语音保留之间的权衡作为显式控制暴露出来：它可以在训练时通过损失加权来设置，并在推理时进行调整。
tldr: 提出了TVBC模型，通过轻量级神经控制器（仅24k参数）实时预测35个双二阶IIR滤波器级联的系数，实现了完全可解释、延迟仅10.7毫秒、可在助听器设备端运行的可控语音降噪。
en_tdlr: TVBC is an interpretable, low-latency speech enhancement model in which a lightweight neural controller (24k parameters) predicts coefficients of a differentiable cascade of 35 biquad IIR filters in real time, enabling fully on-device, controllable denoising within hearing-aid budgets at 10.7ms latency.
